function Get-Payload {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Key)
    if (-not $script:Payloads.ContainsKey($Key)) { throw "STOP: no payload named '$Key'." }
    $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($script:Payloads[$Key])
    return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
}

function Test-Payloads {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 1 - EMBEDDED PAYLOAD VALIDATION'
    $checked = 0
    foreach ($key in @($script:PayloadHashes.Keys)) {
        $text = Get-Payload -Key $key
        $sha = Get-TextSha256 -Text $text
        if ($sha -ne $script:PayloadHashes[$key].ToUpperInvariant()) {
            throw "STOP: payload '$key' failed its own hash check. expected $($script:PayloadHashes[$key]) actual $sha"
        }
        $checked++
    }
    Write-Ok "$checked payload(s) matched their recorded hashes"

    $paths = @($script:Manifest | ForEach-Object { $_.Path })
    if (@($paths | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne $paths.Count) { throw 'STOP: duplicate path in the ownership manifest.' }
    Write-Ok "ownership manifest: $($paths.Count) unique path(s)"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY' -Verdict 'GREEN'
}

function Invoke-Preflight {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:RepoRoot)) { throw "STOP: repository root not found: $script:RepoRoot" }
    Set-Location -LiteralPath $script:RepoRoot
    Write-Ok "repository root $script:RepoRoot"

    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:EvidenceRoot -Force
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:BackupRoot -Force
    Write-Ok "evidence $script:EvidenceRoot"

    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($head)) { throw 'STOP: could not read HEAD.' }
    $script:ObservedHead = $head
    if ($head -ne $script:ExpectedHead) {
        throw "STOP: HEAD is $head; T-091 r8 is anchored to $($script:ExpectedHead) (T-213 CLOSED GREEN). Re-anchor is a CENTRAL decision."
    }
    Write-Ok "HEAD $head (anchored)"

    $staged = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    if ($staged.Count -ne 0) {
        throw "STOP: the index is not empty ($($staged.Count) path(s)). This pack refuses to add to someone else's staging."
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $foreign = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    $script:ForeignBefore = $foreign
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'foreign_before.txt'), ($foreign -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Ok "foreign worktree entries recorded: $($foreign.Count)"

    $owned = @{}
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) { $owned[$entry.Path] = $true }

    foreach ($line in $foreign) {
        if ($line.Length -le 3) { continue }
        $path = $line.Substring(3).Trim().Trim('"')
        if ($owned.ContainsKey($path)) { throw "STOP: owned path already modified in the worktree: $path" }
    }
    Write-Ok 'no owned path is foreign-modified'

    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($entry.Path -replace '/', '\')

        if ($entry.Mode -eq 'New') {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) {
                throw "STOP: new owned file already exists: $($entry.Path). A previous run may have left it behind."
            }
            continue
        }

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { throw "STOP: expected existing owned file is missing: $($entry.Path)" }

        # STRONGER THAN A FROZEN SHA. The file must be exactly what HEAD holds,
        # whatever HEAD now is, so a parallel worker's commit does not fail this
        # pack for a reason unrelated to T-091 while a real local edit still does.
        $clean = Invoke-Git @('diff', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', $entry.Path)
        if ($clean.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            throw "STOP: $($entry.Path) differs from HEAD. Reconcile deliberately before applying T-091."
        }

        $sha = Get-Sha256 -Path $full
        [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText(
            (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'preimages.txt'),
            "$sha  $($entry.Path)`n", (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $full -Destination (Join-Path $script:BackupRoot ($entry.Path -replace '[\\/]', '__')) -Force
    }
    Write-Ok "owned paths verified against HEAD and backed up ($($script:Manifest.Count) entries)"

    Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage 'this run'

    foreach ($tool in @('git', 'dotnet')) {
        $probe = Invoke-Native -FilePath $tool -Arguments @('--version')
        if ($probe.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: $tool is not usable." }
        Write-Inf "$tool $(($probe.StdOut -split "`n")[0].Trim())"
    }

    Add-GateResult -Name 'PREFLIGHT' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    Invoke-BaselineRegression
}

function Write-SourceFile {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Content, [bool] $IsNew)

    $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($Path -replace '/', '\')
    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $full
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force }

    $normalised = ($Content -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $normalised, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    if ($IsNew) { $null = $script:CreatedPaths.Add($full) }
    $null = $script:AppliedPaths.Add($Path)
}

function Invoke-AnchoredPatch {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $PatchKey)

    $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($Path -replace '/', '\')
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    $patch = (Get-Payload -Key $PatchKey) | ConvertFrom-Json

    foreach ($edit in $patch.edits) {
        $anchor = ($edit.anchor -replace "`r`n", "`n")
        $count = ([regex]::Matches($text, [regex]::Escape($anchor))).Count
        if ($count -ne [int] $edit.expected) {
            throw "STOP: anchor '$($edit.id)' in $Path appears $count time(s); expected $($edit.expected)."
        }
        $text = $text.Replace($anchor, ($edit.replacement -replace "`r`n", "`n"))
    }

    foreach ($invariant in $patch.preserveInvariants) {
        if (-not $text.Contains($invariant)) {
            throw "STOP: patching $Path removed a required invariant: $invariant"
        }
    }

    # SHARED-FILE DELTA GUARD (CENTRAL ruling 2). T-213 committed to both
    # composition files. Every line that existed on HEAD must survive with the
    # same count, and the only additions may be T-091's own. Refuse before any
    # build if a foreign registration or mapping moved, vanished or duplicated.
    $before = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    Assert-SharedFileDelta -Path $Path -Before $before -After $text -Patch $patch

    Write-SourceFile -Path $Path -Content $text -IsNew $false
    Write-Ok "patched $Path ($($patch.edits.Count) anchored edit(s))"
}

function Assert-SharedFileDelta {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Before, [string] $After, $Patch)

    $pattern = if ($Path -like '*Program.cs') { 'Map\w*Endpoints\(' }
               elseif ($Path -like '*DependencyInjection.cs') { 'services\.Add(Scoped|Singleton|Transient)<' }
               else { $null }
    if ($null -eq $pattern) { return }

    $beforeLines = @($Before -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match $pattern } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })
    $afterLines  = @($After  -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match $pattern } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })

    # every HEAD line keeps its exact count
    $beforeCounts = @{}
    foreach ($line in $beforeLines) { $beforeCounts[$line] = 1 + $(if ($beforeCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $beforeCounts[$line] } else { 0 }) }
    $afterCounts = @{}
    foreach ($line in $afterLines) { $afterCounts[$line] = 1 + $(if ($afterCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $afterCounts[$line] } else { 0 }) }

    foreach ($line in $beforeCounts.Keys) {
        $seen = $(if ($afterCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $afterCounts[$line] } else { 0 })
        if ($seen -ne $beforeCounts[$line]) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: '$line' appears $($beforeCounts[$line])x on HEAD and $seen x after patching $Path."
        }
    }

    # relative order of HEAD lines preserved
    $beforeOrder = $beforeLines
    $afterFiltered = @($afterLines | Where-Object { $beforeCounts.ContainsKey($_) })
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $beforeOrder.Count; $i++) {
        if ($afterFiltered[$i] -ne $beforeOrder[$i]) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: relative order of HEAD entries changed in $Path at index $i ('$($beforeOrder[$i])' vs '$($afterFiltered[$i])')."
        }
    }

    # the only additions are T-091's own, as declared by the patch replacement
    $added = @($afterLines | Where-Object { -not $beforeCounts.ContainsKey($_) })
    $replacementText = ($Patch.edits | ForEach-Object { $_.replacement }) -join "`n"
    foreach ($line in $added) {
        if (-not $replacementText.Contains($line)) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: unexpected addition in $Path not declared by T-091: '$line'"
        }
    }

    Write-Ok "shared-file delta guard: $Path keeps $($beforeLines.Count) HEAD entr(ies); T-091 adds $($added.Count)"
}

function Invoke-Apply {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 2 - APPLY'

    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        if ($entry.Mode -eq 'New') {
            Write-SourceFile -Path $entry.Path -Content (Get-Payload -Key $entry.Key) -IsNew $true
            Write-Ok "created $($entry.Path)"
        }
        else {
            Invoke-AnchoredPatch -Path $entry.Path -PatchKey $entry.Key
        }
    }

    Add-GateResult -Name 'APPLY' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($script:Manifest.Count) path(s)"
}

function Restore-OwnedSource {
    param([string] $Reason)

    Write-Section 'SOURCE ROLLBACK'
    Write-Warn2 $Reason

    $restored = 0
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        if ($entry.Mode -ne 'Existing') { continue }
        $backup = Join-Path $script:BackupRoot ($entry.Path -replace '[\\/]', '__')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup)) { continue }

        $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($entry.Path -replace '/', '\')
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $backup -Destination $full -Force

        # W1-PACK-ROLLBACK-01: a restored file must look newer than the
        # assemblies built from the mutated source, or the next incremental
        # build reports errors against a repository that is already intact.
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $full).LastWriteTimeUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow
        $restored++
    }

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($path in $script:CreatedPaths) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force; $removed++ }
    }

    Write-Ok "restored $restored file(s), removed $removed created file(s)"

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $after = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    if ($after.Count -ne $script:ForeignBefore.Count) {
        Write-Warn2 "worktree entry count changed: before $($script:ForeignBefore.Count) after $($after.Count)"
    }
    else { Write-Ok 'foreign worktree entries unchanged' }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ build & test ---

$script:ApiProject = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
$script:IntegrationProject = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests.csproj'
$script:ArchitectureProject = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'

function Invoke-Build {
    param([string] $Project, [string] $Label)

    Write-Inf "building $Label"

    Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage "the $Label build"

    $arguments = @('build', $Project, '--nologo', '-v', 'quiet', '/clp:ErrorsOnly')
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 6 -or $arguments[1] -ne $Project) { throw 'STOP: build argument vector is malformed.' }

    $build = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments

    # CENTRAL ruling 13: one internal retry only when the failure signature is
    # a file lock, after a targeted stale-testhost sweep. A second lock is
    # reported as T091_PROCESS_LOCK_RED with the locking details.
    if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $build.Combined -match 'MSB3027|MSB3021|CS2012') {
        Write-Warn2 "$Label hit a file lock; sweeping stale test hosts and retrying once"
        Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage "the $Label retry"
        $build = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments
        if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $build.Combined -match 'MSB3027|MSB3021|CS2012') {
            $lockLine = @($build.Combined -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'locked by|being used by' } | Select-Object -First 3)
            Add-GateResult -Name 'T091_PROCESS_LOCK_RED' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail ($lockLine -join ' | ')
        }
    }

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ("build_" + $Label + ".log")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($log, $build.Combined, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad "compile failed: $Label"

        # W1-PACK-DIAG-03. The old pattern demanded exactly two letters, so
        # MSBuild's own MSB3027 / MSB3021 matched nothing and the pack reported
        # a failure with no reason at all. Compiler codes are CS/NU/xUnit-style,
        # MSBuild codes are MSB: accept any code, and when the filter still
        # matches nothing, show the tail of the log rather than silence.
        $errors = @($build.Combined -split "`n" |
            Where-Object { $_ -match 'error [A-Z]+\d+' } | Select-Object -First 25)

        if ($errors.Count -eq 0) {
            $errors = @($build.Combined -split "`n" |
                Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 } | Select-Object -Last 15)
            Write-Warn2 'no error-coded line matched; showing the end of the build output'
        }

        foreach ($line in $errors) { Write-Host "         $($line.Trim())" }
        Write-Inf "log: $log"
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "compile green: $Label"
    return $true
}

function Invoke-Gate {
    param(
        [string] $Gate,
        [string] $Project,
        [int] $MinimumPassed = 1
    )

    Write-Inf "testing $Gate"

    $filter = 'Gate=' + $Gate
    $trxName = 'test_' + ($Gate -replace '[^\w]', '_') + '.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $Project, '--filter', $filter, '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet', '--logger', $trxLogger, '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot)

    # 0 test | 1 project | 2 --filter | 3 filter | 4 --nologo | 5 --no-build
    # 6 -v | 7 quiet | 8 --logger | 9 logger | 10 --results-directory | 11 path
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 12 -or $arguments[3] -ne $filter -or $arguments[9] -ne $trxLogger -or
        $arguments[11] -ne $script:EvidenceRoot) {
        throw "STOP: test argument vector for $Gate is malformed."
    }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments `
        -Environment @{ 'PPIQ_T091_EVIDENCE' = $script:EvidenceRoot }

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ("test_" + ($Gate -replace '[^\w]', '_') + ".log")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($log, $run.Combined, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $summary = [regex]::Match($run.Combined, 'Failed:\s*(?<failed>\d+),\s*Passed:\s*(?<passed>\d+),\s*Skipped:\s*(?<skipped>\d+),\s*Total:\s*(?<total>\d+)')
    if (-not $summary.Success) {
        Write-Bad "$Gate produced no test summary; the run did not execute"
        Write-Inf "log: $log"
        Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'no summary parsed'
        return $false
    }

    $failed = [int] $summary.Groups['failed'].Value
    $passed = [int] $summary.Groups['passed'].Value

    if ($failed -gt 0 -or $passed -lt $MinimumPassed) {
        Write-Bad "$Gate : $failed failed, $passed passed"
        Show-TrxFailures -TrxPath $trxPath
        Write-Inf "log: $log | trx: $trxPath"
        Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "$failed failed, $passed passed"
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "$Gate : $passed passed"
    Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$passed passed"
    return $true
}

function Read-TrxFailures {
    param([string] $TrxPath)

    $failures = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TrxPath)) { return @() }

    $trx = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $TrxPath -Raw)
    foreach ($result in @($trx.GetElementsByTagName('UnitTestResult'))) {
        if ($result.outcome -ne 'Failed') { continue }
        $message = ''
        $info = $result.GetElementsByTagName('ErrorInfo')
        if ($info.Count -gt 0) {
            $m = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('Message'))
            if ($m.Count -gt 0) { $message = (($m[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 1).Trim() }
        }
        $null = $failures.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string] $result.testName; Message = $message })
    }

    return @($failures)
}

<#
    W1-PACK-BASELINE-01.

    Regression is judged on the DELTA against the unpatched worktree, not on
    an absolute zero and not on a list of names somebody typed. The parallel
    lanes commit and leave worktree state continuously; a failure that already
    exists before T-091 touches a file is inherited by definition, and a
    failure that appears only after is T-091's by definition. The pack measures
    both and decides from the measurement.
#>
function Invoke-BaselineRegression {
    Write-Inf 'baseline: building the architecture suite against the unpatched worktree'

    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ArchitectureProject -Label 'baseline_architecture_tests')) {
        throw 'STOP: the unpatched worktree does not compile the architecture suite; no baseline can be taken.'
    }

    $trxName = 'regression_baseline.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $script:ArchitectureProject, '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet', '--logger', $trxLogger, '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot)
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 10 -or $arguments[7] -ne $trxLogger) { throw 'STOP: baseline argument vector is malformed.' }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_baseline.log'), $run.Combined,
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $summary = [regex]::Match($run.Combined, 'Failed:\s*(?<failed>\d+),\s*Passed:\s*(?<passed>\d+)')
    if (-not $summary.Success) { throw 'STOP: the baseline regression produced no summary.' }

    $failures = Read-TrxFailures -TrxPath $trxPath
    $script:BaselineFailures = @{}
    foreach ($failure in $failures) { $script:BaselineFailures[$failure.Name] = $failure.Message }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_baseline_failures.txt'),
        (($failures | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + ' :: ' + $_.Message }) -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    Write-Ok "baseline: $($summary.Groups['passed'].Value) passed, $($failures.Count) failing on the unpatched worktree (recorded)"
    foreach ($failure in $failures) { Write-Inf "  inherited: $($failure.Name)" }
    Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION_BASELINE' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($failures.Count) pre-existing failure(s) recorded"
}

function Show-TrxFailures {
    param([string] $TrxPath)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TrxPath)) {
        Write-Warn2 'no TRX was produced; details limited to the log'
        return
    }

    try {
        $trx = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $TrxPath -Raw)
        foreach ($result in @($trx.GetElementsByTagName('UnitTestResult'))) {
            if ($result.outcome -ne 'Failed') { continue }
            Write-Host "         FAILED  $($result.testName)"
            $info = $result.GetElementsByTagName('ErrorInfo')
            if ($info.Count -eq 0) { continue }

            $message = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('Message'))
            if ($message.Count -gt 0) {
                foreach ($line in @(($message[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 60)) {
                    Write-Host "           $($line.TrimEnd())"
                }
            }

            $stack = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('StackTrace'))
            if ($stack.Count -gt 0) {
                foreach ($line in @(($stack[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 4)) {
                    Write-Host "           $($line.Trim())"
                }
            }
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Warn2 "could not parse the TRX: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Invoke-AcceptanceMatrix {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 4 - T-091 ACCEPTANCE (risk first: T091-10, T091-11, then the thirteen proven gates)'

    # CENTRAL ruling 11. The unproven contract runs first. If the clean-room
    # round trip is red the pack stops immediately with the semantic diff on
    # screen and in evidence; thirteen already-proven gates are not re-run to
    # learn nothing.
    Write-Inf 'the clean-room round trip copies a database; allow several minutes'

    if (-not (Invoke-Gate -Gate 'T091-10' -Project $script:IntegrationProject)) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'T091-11' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'not reached: T091-10 failed'
        foreach ($name in @('roundtrip_source_semantic.json', 'roundtrip_imported_semantic.json', 'roundtrip_semantic_diff.txt')) {
            $file = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $name
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { Write-Inf "diagnostic: $file" }
        }
        $diff = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'roundtrip_semantic_diff.txt'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $diff) {
            Write-Host ''
            Write-Host '  SEMANTIC DIFF (source vs imported):'
            foreach ($line in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $diff | Select-Object -First 40)) { Write-Host "    $line" }
        }
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  ACCEPTANCE: stopped at T091-10' -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    # T091-11 is asserted inside the same test against the database the first
    # import produced: second identical import -> 0 definitions, 0 versions,
    # 0 edges. The only place that comparison means anything.
    Add-GateResult -Name 'T091-11' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail 'second identical import: 0 definitions, 0 versions, 0 edges (asserted inside T091-10)'

    $green = 2
    $proven = @(
        'T091-01', 'T091-02', 'T091-03', 'T091-04', 'T091-05',
        'T091-06', 'T091-07', 'T091-08', 'T091-09',
        'T091-12', 'T091-13', 'T091-14', 'T091-15')

    foreach ($gate in $proven) {
        if (Invoke-Gate -Gate $gate -Project $script:IntegrationProject) { $green++ }
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "  ACCEPTANCE: $green/15 GREEN" -ForegroundColor $(if ($green -eq 15) { 'Green' } else { 'Red' })
    return ($green -eq 15)
}

function Invoke-Regression {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 5 - REGRESSION'

    $trxName = 'regression.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $script:ArchitectureProject, '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet', '--logger', $trxLogger, '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot)

    # 0 test | 1 project | 2 --nologo | 3 --no-build | 4 -v | 5 quiet
    # 6 --logger | 7 logger | 8 --results-directory | 9 path
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 10 -or $arguments[7] -ne $trxLogger -or
        $arguments[9] -ne $script:EvidenceRoot) { throw 'STOP: regression argument vector is malformed.' }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression.log'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($log, $run.Combined, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $summary = [regex]::Match($run.Combined, 'Failed:\s*(?<failed>\d+),\s*Passed:\s*(?<passed>\d+)')
    if (-not $summary.Success) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'no summary parsed'
        return $false
    }

    $failed = [int] $summary.Groups['failed'].Value
    if ($failed -eq 0) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($summary.Groups['passed'].Value) passed"
        return $true
    }

    $failures = Read-TrxFailures -TrxPath $trxPath

    # Three classes, decided by measurement. INHERITED: the same identity
    # failed at baseline, before any T-091 file existed. WAIVED: an operator
    # named it explicitly. BLOCKING: everything else - a failure that T-091's
    # presence introduced, which is the only kind this gate exists to stop.
    $blocking = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    $inherited = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    $waived = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

    foreach ($failure in $failures) {
        if ($script:BaselineFailures.ContainsKey($failure.Name)) { $null = $inherited.Add($failure); continue }

        $isWaived = $false
        foreach ($accepted in $AcceptInheritedRegression) {
            if ($failure.Name.EndsWith($accepted, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { $isWaived = $true }
        }
        if ($isWaived) { $null = $waived.Add($failure) } else { $null = $blocking.Add($failure) }
    }

    foreach ($failure in $inherited) {
        Write-Warn2 "INHERITED (identical failure on the unpatched worktree): $($failure.Name)"
        if ($failure.Message) { Write-Host "           $($failure.Message)" }
    }
    foreach ($failure in $waived) {
        Write-Warn2 "WAIVED (operator authority, not at baseline): $($failure.Name)"
        if ($failure.Message) { Write-Host "           $($failure.Message)" }
    }
    foreach ($failure in $blocking) {
        Write-Bad "REGRESSION (introduced by T-091): $($failure.Name)"
        if ($failure.Message) { Write-Host "           $($failure.Message)" }
    }

    $script:RegressionInherited = @($inherited | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
    $script:RegressionWaived = @($waived | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_inherited.txt'),
        (($inherited | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + ' :: ' + $_.Message }) -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_waivers.txt'), ($script:RegressionWaived -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    if ($blocking.Count -gt 0 -or $failures.Count -ne $failed) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "$($blocking.Count) introduced, $($inherited.Count) inherited, $($waived.Count) waived"
        Write-Inf "log: $log | trx: $trxPath"
        return $false
    }

    Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "0 introduced; $($inherited.Count) inherited (baseline-proven); $($waived.Count) waived"
    return $true
}

# ------------------------------------------------------ ownership & commit ---

function Invoke-OwnershipGateAndCommit {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 6 - OWNERSHIP GATE AND COMMIT'

    # EXACT FILES ONLY. Never git add -A: this repository carries 100+ foreign
    # worktree entries belonging to other lanes, and a broad add would commit
    # someone else's unfinished work under this task's message.
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        $add = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $entry.Path)
        if ($add.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: could not stage $($entry.Path): $($add.StdErr)" }
    }

    # W1-PACK-CRLF-01. git prints LF; the capture appends CRLF; a path split on
    # LF alone keeps its trailing CR and never equals the manifest path. The
    # last run refused its own fifteen files on exactly that character.
    $staged = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })
    $owned = @{}
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) { $owned[$entry.Path] = $true }

    $foreignStaged = @($staged | Where-Object { -not $owned.ContainsKey($_) })
    if ($foreignStaged.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "STOP: the index contains path(s) this task does not own: " + ($foreignStaged -join ', ')
    }

    foreach ($path in $staged) { Write-Inf "staged $path" }
    Write-Ok "$($staged.Count) owned path(s) staged, nothing foreign"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'OWNERSHIP' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($staged.Count) owned path(s) staged"

    $message = 'Add dependency impact preview and portable definition export/import'
    $commit = Invoke-Git @('commit', '-m', $message)
    if ($commit.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: commit failed: $($commit.Combined)" }

    $script:CommitSha = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    Write-Ok "committed $script:CommitSha"
}

function Write-ClosureProof {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 7 - POST-COMMIT PROOF'

    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    $files = (Invoke-Git @('show', '--stat', '--name-only', '--pretty=format:', 'HEAD')).StdOut
    $index = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $foreignAfter = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "  parent HEAD       : $($script:ObservedHead)"
    Write-Host "  HEAD              : $head"
    Write-Host "  commit            : $($script:CommitSha)"
    Write-Host "  index after commit: $($index.Count) path(s)"
    Write-Host "  foreign entries   : before $($script:ForeignBefore.Count) / after $($foreignAfter.Count)"
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  COMMITTED PATHS'
    foreach ($line in ($files -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })) { Write-Host "    $line" }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  GATE RESULTS'
    foreach ($gate in $script:GateResults) {
        $mark = if ($gate.Verdict -eq 'GREEN') { ' ' } else { '!' }
        Write-Host ("   $mark {0,-34} {1} {2}" -f $gate.Gate, $gate.Verdict, $gate.Detail)
    }

    if (@($script:RegressionInherited).Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  INHERITED REGRESSION FAILURES (identical on the unpatched worktree; recorded, not fixed)'
        foreach ($name in $script:RegressionInherited) { Write-Host "    $name" }
    }

    if (@($script:RegressionWaived).Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  REGRESSION FAILURES WAIVED BY OPERATOR AUTHORITY'
        foreach ($name in $script:RegressionWaived) { Write-Host "    $name" }
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  T-091 SCOPE STATEMENT'
    Write-Host '    zero DDL: no migration script, no canonical-migration-order.json edit, no new table.'
    Write-Host '    impact is a read model over ppiq_meta.definition_dependencies (T-089 authority).'
    Write-Host '    every imported semantic write goes through ICanonicalDefinitionWriter (T-090 authority).'

    $red = @($script:GateResults | Where-Object { $_.Verdict -ne 'GREEN' })
    Write-Host ''

    if ($red.Count -eq 0 -and $index.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host '  T-091 CLOSED GREEN' -ForegroundColor Green
        return $true
    }

    Write-Host "  T-091 NOT CLOSED - $($red.Count) gate(s) red" -ForegroundColor Red
    return $false
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- main ----

Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'PPIQ T-091 - Impact preview, export and import'
Write-Host 'zero DDL; consumes the committed T-089 dependency store and T-090 canonical writer'

$script:ObservedHead = ''
$exitCode = 1

try {
    Invoke-Preflight
    Test-Payloads
    Invoke-Apply

    Write-Section 'PHASE 3 - COMPILE'
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ApiProject -Label 'api')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:IntegrationProject -Label 'integration_tests')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ArchitectureProject -Label 'architecture_tests')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    Add-GateResult -Name 'COMPILE' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    if (-not (Invoke-AcceptanceMatrix)) { throw 'ACCEPTANCE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Regression)) { throw 'REGRESSION_RED' }

    Invoke-OwnershipGateAndCommit

    if (Write-ClosureProof) { $exitCode = 0 }
}
catch {
    $reason = $_.Exception.Message

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad "T-091 stopped: $reason"

    if ($script:CommitSha -eq '') {
        # Clear anything this run staged BEFORE the rollback compares worktree
        # counts, so the comparison measures the worktree and not the index.
        $reset = Invoke-Git @('reset')
        if ($reset.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Warn2 'could not clear the index; inspect git status before rerunning' }

        Restore-OwnedSource -Reason $reason
    }
    else {
        Write-Warn2 'the commit already landed; source was NOT rolled back'
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  GATE RESULTS'
    foreach ($gate in $script:GateResults) {
        $mark = if ($gate.Verdict -eq 'GREEN') { ' ' } else { '!' }
        Write-Host ("   $mark {0,-34} {1} {2}" -f $gate.Gate, $gate.Verdict, $gate.Detail)
    }

    $exitCode = 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host "  evidence: $script:EvidenceRoot"
exit $exitCode

<#
    PPIQ T-210 - Canonical signal and aggregation semantics authority.

    WHAT THIS PACK DOES
      Extends ppiq_meta.parameter_definitions and ppiq_meta.kpi_parameter_bindings
      with governed signal semantics (migration 834), publishes the product
      grammar and the single resolver, and normalises two inherited manifest

    HEAD ANCHORING
      Anchored to the T-091 commit. Every owned existing file is additionally
      verified IDENTICAL TO HEAD with git diff --quiet before it is touched.

      inlined into an array where the comma operator binds tighter than '+'.
      Positions are asserted before any native process is started.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string[]] $AcceptInheritedRegression = @()

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# CENTRAL producer authority for T-210: T-091 CLOSED GREEN at this HEAD.

function Write-Section {
    param([string] $Title)
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ('=' * 78)
    Write-Host $Title
    Write-Host ('=' * 78)
}

function Write-Ok  { param([string] $Message) Write-Host "  [OK]   $Message" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Inf { param([string] $Message) Write-Host "  [INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Gray }
function Write-Warn2 { param([string] $Message) Write-Host "  [WARN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Warn  { param([string] $Message) Write-Warn2 -Message $Message }
function Write-Bad { param([string] $Message) Write-Host "  [FAIL] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red }

function Add-GateResult {
    param([string] $Name, [string] $Verdict, [string] $Detail = '')
    $null = $script:GateResults.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Gate = $Name; Verdict = $Verdict; Detail = $Detail })
}

function Get-Sha256 {
    param([string] $Path)
    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToUpperInvariant()
}

function Get-TextSha256 {
    param([string] $Text)
    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Text)
    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($bytes)).Replace('-', '').ToUpperInvariant()
}

function ConvertTo-CommandLine {
    param([string[]] $Arguments)
    $parts = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    foreach ($argument in $Arguments) {
        if ($null -eq $argument) { continue }
        if ($argument.Length -gt 0 -and $argument -notmatch '[\s"]') { $null = $parts.Add($argument) }
        else { $null = $parts.Add('"' + ($argument -replace '"', '\"') + '"') }
    }
    return ($parts -join ' ')
}

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $FilePath,
        [string[]] $Arguments = @(),
        [hashtable] $Environment = @{}
    )

    $info = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $info.FileName = $FilePath
    $info.Arguments = ConvertTo-CommandLine -Arguments $Arguments
    $info.WorkingDirectory = $script:RepoRoot
    $info.UseShellExecute = $false
    $info.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $info.RedirectStandardError = $true
    $info.RedirectStandardInput = $true
    $info.CreateNoWindow = $true

    foreach ($key in $Environment.Keys) { $info.EnvironmentVariables[$key] = $Environment[$key] }

    $process = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process
    $process.StartInfo = $info

    $out = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $err = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder

    $outEvent = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $process -EventName OutputDataReceived -MessageData $out -Action {
        if ($null -ne $EventArgs.Data) { $null = $Event.MessageData.AppendLine($EventArgs.Data) }
    }
    $errEvent = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $process -EventName ErrorDataReceived -MessageData $err -Action {
        if ($null -ne $EventArgs.Data) { $null = $Event.MessageData.AppendLine($EventArgs.Data) }
    }

    try {
        $null = $process.Start()
        $process.BeginOutputReadLine()
        $process.BeginErrorReadLine()
        $process.StandardInput.Close()
        $process.WaitForExit()
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 120
    }
    finally {
        Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $outEvent.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $errEvent.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    $stdout = $out.ToString()
    $stderr = $err.ToString()

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $process.ExitCode
        StdOut   = $stdout
        StdErr   = $stderr
        Combined = $stdout + "`n" + $stderr
    }
}

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]] $Arguments)
    return Invoke-Native -FilePath 'git' -Arguments $Arguments
}

<#
    W1-PACK-TESTHOST-01.

    A dotnet test run that dies - killed, timed out, or failed hard enough to
    abandon its worker - leaves a testhost process holding the test project's
    output assemblies. Every later build then fails with MSB3027 "the file is
    locked by testhost", which reads like a broken repository and is a stale
    process. The pack owns its own workspace, so it clears them itself rather
    than handing over a manual step.

    Only testhost processes are touched. The build server, the IDE and anything
    else are left alone.
#>
function Stop-StaleTestHost {
    param([string] $Stage)

    $stale = @(Get-Process -Name 'testhost', 'testhost.x86' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($stale.Count -eq 0) { return }

    foreach ($process in $stale) {
        try {
            Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            Write-Warn2 "stopped stale testhost $($process.Id) before $Stage"
        }
        catch {
            Write-Warn2 "could not stop testhost $($process.Id): $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }

    # The file handles are released asynchronously; a build started in the same
    # instant can still lose the race.
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
}

function Resolve-Psql {
    $candidate = 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { return $candidate }
    return 'psql'
}


function Invoke-Psql {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Sql,
        [string] $Database = $script:PgDatabase,
        [switch] $StopOnError
    )

    $stem = 'psql_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('n')
    $file = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ($stem + '.sql')
    $out  = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ($stem + '.out')

    # PROOF OF EXECUTION.
    #
    # \qecho writes to the QUERY OUTPUT stream, so this line reaches the -o file
    # if and only if psql actually opened and executed THIS file. Without it, a
    # psql that read an already-closed stdin exits 0 having run nothing and is
    # indistinguishable from a successful run. That is exactly what happened in
    # r20 and it turned every database gate into a vacuous green.
    $sentinel = 'PPIQ_PSQL_EXECUTED'
    $payload  = '\qecho ' + $sentinel + "`n" + $Sql
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($file, $payload, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $stopValue = '0'
    if ($StopOnError) { $stopValue = '1' }
    $onErrorStop = 'ON_ERROR_STOP=' + $stopValue

    # W1-DB-PSQL-01 - THE ARGUMENT VECTOR IS BUILT FROM PLAIN ELEMENTS ONLY.
    #
    # In PowerShell the comma operator binds TIGHTER than '+'. Writing
    #     @('-v', 'ON_ERROR_STOP=' + $x, '-o', $out, '-f', $file)
    # is therefore parsed as
    #     @('-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=') + @($x,'-o',$out,'-f',$file)
    # which produced the command line
    #     -v ON_ERROR_STOP=  1  -o <out> -f <file>
    # The getopt PostgreSQL ships on Windows does NOT permute: it stops at the
    # first non-option argument ("1"), so -o and -f were never parsed at all.
    # psql then took its script from stdin, which this runner closes at start,
    # executed nothing, wrote no output file and exited 0.
    #
    # No expression is ever inlined into this array again.
    $arguments = @(
        '-w',
        '-h', $script:PgHost,
        '-p', $script:PgPort,
        '-U', $script:PgUser,
        '-d', $Database,
        '-v', $onErrorStop,
        '-o', $out,
        '-f', $file
    )

    # Shape guard. If the vector is ever reshaped, stop rather than let psql
    # silently ignore the options that carry the work.
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 15) { throw "STOP: psql argument vector has $($arguments.Count) elements, expected 15." }
    if ($arguments[9]  -ne '-v')  { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at -v.' }
    if ($arguments[10] -ne $onErrorStop) { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at ON_ERROR_STOP.' }
    if ($arguments[11] -ne '-o')  { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at -o.' }
    if ($arguments[12] -ne $out)  { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at the output path.' }
    if ($arguments[13] -ne '-f')  { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at -f.' }
    if ($arguments[14] -ne $file) { throw 'STOP: psql argument vector is malformed at the script path.' }

    $result = Invoke-Native -FilePath (Resolve-Psql) -Arguments $arguments `
        -Environment @{ 'PGPASSWORD' = $script:PgPassword }

    $captured = ''
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out) { $captured = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($out) }

    # A zero exit code is only believed when the sentinel proves the file ran.
    if ($result.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $captured.Contains($sentinel)) {
        throw ("STOP: psql exited 0 without executing $file. The execution sentinel is absent from $out, " +
               "so no statement in that file ran. Reading this as success would report a vacuous green.")
    }

    # The sentinel is evidence for this function only. Strip it so an empty
    # result set still reads as empty to every caller and the vacuity checks
    # downstream keep their meaning.
    $clean = (@($captured -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne $sentinel }) -join "`n")

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $result.ExitCode
        StdOut   = $clean
        StdErr   = $result.StdErr
        Combined = $clean + "`n" + $result.Combined
    }
}


function New-DisposableDatabase {
    Write-Inf "creating disposable database $($script:ProbeDatabase)"
    Write-Inf 'the EF baseline and 100-script replay that follow take several minutes'

    # WITH (FORCE) so an orphaned probe from an aborted run cannot block a rerun.
    $drop = Invoke-Psql -Database 'postgres' -Sql (
        "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $($script:ProbeDatabase) WITH (FORCE);`n" +
        "CREATE DATABASE $($script:ProbeDatabase);")

    if ($drop.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "STOP: could not create the disposable database. $($drop.StdErr)"
    }

    $script:ProbeCreated = $true
    Write-Ok "disposable database ready"
}


function Remove-DisposableDatabase {
    if (-not $script:ProbeCreated) { return }

    $drop = Invoke-Psql -Database 'postgres' -Sql "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $($script:ProbeDatabase) WITH (FORCE);"
    if ($drop.ExitCode -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'disposable database dropped' }
    else { Write-Warn "disposable database was not dropped: $($drop.StdErr)" }

    $script:ProbeCreated = $false
}


function Invoke-CanonicalReplay {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Database)

    $manifestPath = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
    $manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    $steps = @($manifest.canonicalPath | Sort-Object { [int] $_.position })
    if ($steps.Count -eq 0) { throw 'STOP: the canonical path is empty; the replay would be vacuous.' }

    Write-Inf "EF baseline"
    $ef = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments @(
        'ef', 'database', 'update',
        '--project', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure',
        '--startup-project', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api',
        '--no-build') -Environment @{
            'ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb' =
                "Host=$($script:PgHost);Port=$($script:PgPort);Database=$Database;Username=$($script:PgUser);Password=$($script:PgPassword)"
        }

    if ($ef.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad "EF baseline failed on $Database"
        Write-Host $ef.Combined
        return $false
    }

    $applied = 0
    foreach ($step in $steps) {
        $file = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) {
            Write-Bad "canonical path names a missing script: $($step.path)"
            return $false
        }

        $sql = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file)

        # Print progress. A long silent stretch is indistinguishable from a
        # hang, and telling them apart cost a whole run.
        if (($applied % 10) -eq 0) {
            Write-Inf "replaying $($step.position)/$($steps.Count): $(Split-Path -Leaf $step.path)"
        }

        $run = Invoke-Psql -Database $Database -Sql $sql -StopOnError

        if ($run.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            Write-Bad "position $($step.position) failed: $($step.path)"
            Write-Host ($run.Combined -split "`n" | Select-Object -First 20 | Out-String)
            return $false
        }
        $applied++
    }

    Write-Ok "canonical replay applied $applied script(s) to $Database"
    return $true
}

    [pscustomobject]@{ Path = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests/Definitions/Semantics/T210SemanticsFixture.cs'; Mode = 'New'; Key = 'cs.fixture'; Role = 'schema-discovering neutral fixture' }
