)

function Get-Payload {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Key)
    if (-not $script:Payloads.ContainsKey($Key)) { throw "STOP: no payload named '$Key'." }
    $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($script:Payloads[$Key])
    return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
}

function Test-Payloads {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 1 - EMBEDDED PAYLOAD VALIDATION'
    $checked = 0
    foreach ($key in @($script:PayloadHashes.Keys)) {
        $text = Get-Payload -Key $key
        $sha = Get-TextSha256 -Text $text
        if ($sha -ne $script:PayloadHashes[$key].ToUpperInvariant()) {
            throw "STOP: payload '$key' failed its own hash check. expected $($script:PayloadHashes[$key]) actual $sha"
        }
        $checked++
    }
    Write-Ok "$checked payload(s) matched their recorded hashes"

    $paths = @($script:Manifest | ForEach-Object { $_.Path })
    if (@($paths | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne $paths.Count) { throw 'STOP: duplicate path in the ownership manifest.' }
    Write-Ok "ownership manifest: $($paths.Count) unique path(s)"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY' -Verdict 'GREEN'
}

function Invoke-Preflight {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:RepoRoot)) { throw "STOP: repository root not found: $script:RepoRoot" }
    Set-Location -LiteralPath $script:RepoRoot
    Write-Ok "repository root $script:RepoRoot"

    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:EvidenceRoot -Force
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:BackupRoot -Force
    Write-Ok "evidence $script:EvidenceRoot"

    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($head)) { throw 'STOP: could not read HEAD.' }
    $script:ObservedHead = $head
    if ($head -ne $script:ExpectedHead) {
        throw "STOP: HEAD is $head; T-091 r8 is anchored to $($script:ExpectedHead) (T-213 CLOSED GREEN). Re-anchor is a CENTRAL decision."
    }
    Write-Ok "HEAD $head (anchored)"

    $staged = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    if ($staged.Count -ne 0) {
        throw "STOP: the index is not empty ($($staged.Count) path(s)). This pack refuses to add to someone else's staging."
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $foreign = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    $script:ForeignBefore = $foreign
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'foreign_before.txt'), ($foreign -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Ok "foreign worktree entries recorded: $($foreign.Count)"

    $owned = @{}
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) { $owned[$entry.Path] = $true }

    foreach ($line in $foreign) {
        if ($line.Length -le 3) { continue }
        $path = $line.Substring(3).Trim().Trim('"')
        if ($owned.ContainsKey($path)) { throw "STOP: owned path already modified in the worktree: $path" }
    }
    Write-Ok 'no owned path is foreign-modified'

    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($entry.Path -replace '/', '\')

        if ($entry.Mode -eq 'New') {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) {
                throw "STOP: new owned file already exists: $($entry.Path). A previous run may have left it behind."
            }
            continue
        }

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { throw "STOP: expected existing owned file is missing: $($entry.Path)" }

        # STRONGER THAN A FROZEN SHA. The file must be exactly what HEAD holds,
        # whatever HEAD now is, so a parallel worker's commit does not fail this
        # pack for a reason unrelated to T-091 while a real local edit still does.
        $clean = Invoke-Git @('diff', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', $entry.Path)
        if ($clean.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            throw "STOP: $($entry.Path) differs from HEAD. Reconcile deliberately before applying T-091."
        }

        $sha = Get-Sha256 -Path $full
        [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText(
            (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'preimages.txt'),
            "$sha  $($entry.Path)`n", (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $full -Destination (Join-Path $script:BackupRoot ($entry.Path -replace '[\\/]', '__')) -Force
    }
    Write-Ok "owned paths verified against HEAD and backed up ($($script:Manifest.Count) entries)"

    Assert-PredecessorBookkeepingState
    Write-TargetTableShapes
    Write-Inf "ppiq_app T-210 state: $(Get-SharedDatabaseState)"

    Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage 'this run'

    foreach ($tool in @('git', 'dotnet')) {
        $probe = Invoke-Native -FilePath $tool -Arguments @('--version')
        if ($probe.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: $tool is not usable." }
        Write-Inf "$tool $(($probe.StdOut -split "`n")[0].Trim())"
    }

    Add-GateResult -Name 'PREFLIGHT' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    Invoke-BaselineRegression
}

function Write-SourceFile {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Content, [bool] $IsNew)

    $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($Path -replace '/', '\')
    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $full
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force }

    $normalised = ($Content -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $normalised, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    if ($IsNew) { $null = $script:CreatedPaths.Add($full) }
    $null = $script:AppliedPaths.Add($Path)
}

function Invoke-AnchoredPatch {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $PatchKey)

    $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($Path -replace '/', '\')
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    $patch = (Get-Payload -Key $PatchKey) | ConvertFrom-Json

    foreach ($edit in $patch.edits) {
        $anchor = ($edit.anchor -replace "`r`n", "`n")
        $count = ([regex]::Matches($text, [regex]::Escape($anchor))).Count
        if ($count -ne [int] $edit.expected) {
            throw "STOP: anchor '$($edit.id)' in $Path appears $count time(s); expected $($edit.expected)."
        }
        $text = $text.Replace($anchor, ($edit.replacement -replace "`r`n", "`n"))
    }

    foreach ($invariant in $patch.preserveInvariants) {
        if (-not $text.Contains($invariant)) {
            throw "STOP: patching $Path removed a required invariant: $invariant"
        }
    }

    # SHARED-FILE DELTA GUARD (CENTRAL ruling 2). T-213 committed to both
    # composition files. Every line that existed on HEAD must survive with the
    # same count, and the only additions may be T-091's own. Refuse before any
    # build if a foreign registration or mapping moved, vanished or duplicated.
    $before = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    Assert-SharedFileDelta -Path $Path -Before $before -After $text -Patch $patch

    Write-SourceFile -Path $Path -Content $text -IsNew $false
    Write-Ok "patched $Path ($($patch.edits.Count) anchored edit(s))"
}

function Write-TargetTableShapes {
    # The two authorities T-210 extends are not described by any source this
    # pack carries; their shape is measured and recorded, never assumed.
    $shape = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:PgDatabase -Sql @"
\pset tuples_only on
\pset format unaligned
SELECT table_name || ': ' || string_agg(column_name || ' ' || data_type || CASE WHEN is_nullable = 'NO' THEN ' NOT NULL' ELSE '' END, ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position)
  FROM information_schema.columns
 WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta' AND table_name IN ('parameter_definitions', 'kpi_parameter_bindings')
 GROUP BY table_name;
"@
    if ($shape.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: could not read the target table shapes: $($shape.StdErr)" }
    $lines = @($shape.StdOut -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'target_table_shapes.txt'), ($lines -join "`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    foreach ($line in $lines) { Write-Inf "shape: $line" }
}

function Assert-SharedFileDelta {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Before, [string] $After, $Patch)

    $pattern = if ($Path -like '*Program.cs') { 'Map\w*Endpoints\(' }
               elseif ($Path -like '*DependencyInjection.cs') { 'services\.Add(Scoped|Singleton|Transient)<' }
               else { $null }
    if ($null -eq $pattern) { return }

    $beforeLines = @($Before -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match $pattern } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })
    $afterLines  = @($After  -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match $pattern } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })

    # every HEAD line keeps its exact count
    $beforeCounts = @{}
    foreach ($line in $beforeLines) { $beforeCounts[$line] = 1 + $(if ($beforeCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $beforeCounts[$line] } else { 0 }) }
    $afterCounts = @{}
    foreach ($line in $afterLines) { $afterCounts[$line] = 1 + $(if ($afterCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $afterCounts[$line] } else { 0 }) }

    foreach ($line in $beforeCounts.Keys) {
        $seen = $(if ($afterCounts.ContainsKey($line)) { $afterCounts[$line] } else { 0 })
        if ($seen -ne $beforeCounts[$line]) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: '$line' appears $($beforeCounts[$line])x on HEAD and $seen x after patching $Path."
        }
    }

    # relative order of HEAD lines preserved
    $beforeOrder = $beforeLines
    $afterFiltered = @($afterLines | Where-Object { $beforeCounts.ContainsKey($_) })
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $beforeOrder.Count; $i++) {
        if ($afterFiltered[$i] -ne $beforeOrder[$i]) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: relative order of HEAD entries changed in $Path at index $i ('$($beforeOrder[$i])' vs '$($afterFiltered[$i])')."
        }
    }

    # the only additions are T-091's own, as declared by the patch replacement
    $added = @($afterLines | Where-Object { -not $beforeCounts.ContainsKey($_) })
    $replacementText = ($Patch.edits | ForEach-Object { $_.replacement }) -join "`n"
    foreach ($line in $added) {
        if (-not $replacementText.Contains($line)) {
            throw "STOP: shared-file delta guard: unexpected addition in $Path not declared by T-091: '$line'"
        }
    }

    Write-Ok "shared-file delta guard: $Path keeps $($beforeLines.Count) HEAD entr(ies); T-091 adds $($added.Count)"
}

function Invoke-Apply {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 2 - APPLY'

    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        if ($entry.Mode -eq 'New') {
            Write-SourceFile -Path $entry.Path -Content (Get-Payload -Key $entry.Key) -IsNew $true
            Write-Ok "created $($entry.Path)"
        }
        elseif ($entry.Key -ne '') {
            Invoke-AnchoredPatch -Path $entry.Path -PatchKey $entry.Key
        }
    }

    Update-CanonicalManifest

    Add-GateResult -Name 'APPLY' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($script:Manifest.Count) path(s)"
}

function Restore-OwnedSource {
    param([string] $Reason)

    Write-Section 'SOURCE ROLLBACK'
    Write-Warn2 $Reason

    $restored = 0
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        if ($entry.Mode -ne 'Existing') { continue }
        $backup = Join-Path $script:BackupRoot ($entry.Path -replace '[\\/]', '__')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup)) { continue }

        $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($entry.Path -replace '/', '\')
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $backup -Destination $full -Force

        # W1-PACK-ROLLBACK-01: a restored file must look newer than the
        # assemblies built from the mutated source, or the next incremental
        # build reports errors against a repository that is already intact.
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $full).LastWriteTimeUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow
        $restored++
    }

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($path in $script:CreatedPaths) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force; $removed++ }
    }

    Write-Ok "restored $restored file(s), removed $removed created file(s)"

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $after = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    if ($after.Count -ne $script:ForeignBefore.Count) {
        Write-Warn2 "worktree entry count changed: before $($script:ForeignBefore.Count) after $($after.Count)"
    }
    else { Write-Ok 'foreign worktree entries unchanged' }
}

# ------------------------------------------------- canonical manifest ------
#
# CENTRAL ruling 5 (T-210): the manifest update is an ALGORITHM, not a hand
# edit, so the view-order drift that produced PREDECESSOR-MANIFEST-02 cannot
# recur on 835/836:
#
#   1. locate the final schema insertion point (before the first view);
#   2. insert the new script there;
#   3. renumber canonicalPath positions deterministically from 1;
#   4. derive every canonicalViews.order from its canonicalPath entry;
#   5. assert strict schema-before-view ordering;
#   6. verify every recorded SHA against the actual file (CRLF-safe: the hash
#      is taken over the bytes on disk, which is what the architecture test
#      hashes too), normalising representation to uppercase;
#   7. serialize deterministically.

$script:T210ScriptPath = 'Backend/database/scripts/834_signal_aggregation_semantics.sql'

function Assert-PredecessorBookkeepingState {
    # Prove the two inherited states EXACTLY before touching them, so the
    # normalisation is applied to the defect that was measured and not to
    # something a later commit changed.
    $path = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
    $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    $entry833 = @($json.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -like '*833_customer_assessment_history.sql' })
    if ($entry833.Count -ne 1) { throw 'STOP: 833 is not on the canonical path exactly once; the predecessor baseline has changed.' }
    $recorded = [string] $entry833[0].sha256
    $actual = Get-Sha256 -Path (Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($entry833[0].path -replace '/', '\'))
    if ($recorded -ceq $actual) {
        Write-Inf 'PREDECESSOR-MANIFEST-01 already normalised upstream; nothing to correct'
    }
    elseif ($recorded.ToUpperInvariant() -eq $actual) {
        Write-Ok "PREDECESSOR-MANIFEST-01 proven: 833 recorded '$recorded' (lowercase) vs actual '$actual'"
    }
    else {
        throw "STOP: 833 recorded SHA $recorded does not match the file ($actual) even ignoring case; this is not the measured bookkeeping defect."
    }

    $lastSchema = ($json.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -notlike 'Backend/database/views/*' } | Measure-Object -Property position -Maximum).Maximum
    foreach ($view in $json.canonicalViews) {
        $onPath = @($json.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $view.path })
        if ($onPath.Count -ne 1) { throw "STOP: view $($view.path) is not on the canonical path exactly once." }
        Write-Ok "PREDECESSOR-MANIFEST-02 proven: view order $($view.order), path position $($onPath[0].position), last schema position $lastSchema"
    }
}

function Update-CanonicalManifest {
    $path = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
    $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    $scriptFull = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($script:T210ScriptPath -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scriptFull)) { throw "STOP: $($script:T210ScriptPath) was not written before the manifest update." }

    if (@($json.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $script:T210ScriptPath }).Count -ne 0) {
        throw 'STOP: 834 is already on the canonical path.'
    }

    $template = @($json.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -like '*833_customer_assessment_history.sql' })[0]
    $entry = [pscustomobject]@{}
    foreach ($property in $template.PSObject.Properties) {
        $entry | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $property.Name -NotePropertyValue $property.Value
    }
    $entry.path = $script:T210ScriptPath
    $entry.sha256 = Get-Sha256 -Path $scriptFull
    $entry.disposition = 'Canonical'
    if ($entry.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'reason') {
        $entry.reason = 'T-210 signal and aggregation semantics authority: grammar, parameter semantics, KPI overrides, governed history, single resolver.'
    }

    # 1-2. insert before the first view
    $ordered = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    $inserted = $false
    foreach ($step in @($json.canonicalPath | Sort-Object { [int] $_.position })) {
        if (-not $inserted -and $step.path -like 'Backend/database/views/*') {
            $null = $ordered.Add($entry); $inserted = $true
        }
        $null = $ordered.Add($step)
    }
    if (-not $inserted) { $null = $ordered.Add($entry) }

    # 3. renumber; 6. verify and normalise every recorded SHA
    $position = 1
    foreach ($step in $ordered) {
        $step.position = $position
        $position++

        $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRoot ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { throw "STOP: canonical path names a missing file: $($step.path)" }
        $actual = Get-Sha256 -Path $full
        $recorded = ([string] $step.sha256).ToUpperInvariant()
        if ($recorded -ne $actual) {
            throw "STOP: $($step.path) at position $($step.position): recorded SHA $($step.sha256) does not match the file ($actual)."
        }
        $step.sha256 = $actual   # canonical uppercase representation
    }

    # 4. derive view order from path position; 5. assert schema-before-view
    $lastSchema = ($ordered | Where-Object { $_.path -notlike 'Backend/database/views/*' } | Measure-Object -Property position -Maximum).Maximum
    foreach ($view in $json.canonicalViews) {
        $onPath = @($ordered | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $view.path })
        if ($onPath.Count -ne 1) { throw "STOP: view $($view.path) is not on the canonical path exactly once." }
        $view.order = [int] $onPath[0].position
        if ($view.order -le $lastSchema) {
            throw "STOP: view $($view.path) order $($view.order) is not after the last schema position $lastSchema."
        }
    }

    $json.canonicalPath = $ordered.ToArray()
    if ($json.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'summary' -and $json.summary.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'canonicalPath') {
        $json.summary.canonicalPath = $ordered.Count
    }

    # 7. deterministic serialization, LF inside then the file's CRLF convention
    $text = ($json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 40) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    Write-SourceFile -Path 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json' -Content $text -IsNew $false

    $new = @($ordered | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $script:T210ScriptPath })[0]
    $viewOrders = ($json.canonicalViews | ForEach-Object { $_.order }) -join ','
    Write-Ok "manifest: $($ordered.Count) entries renumbered; 834 at position $($new.position); last schema $lastSchema; view order(s) $viewOrders"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'MANIFEST' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "834 at $($new.position); views $viewOrders"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ build & test ---

$script:ApiProject = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
$script:IntegrationProject = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests.csproj'
$script:ArchitectureProject = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'

function Invoke-Build {
    param([string] $Project, [string] $Label)

    Write-Inf "building $Label"

    Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage "the $Label build"

    $arguments = @('build', $Project, '--nologo', '-v', 'quiet', '/clp:ErrorsOnly')
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 6 -or $arguments[1] -ne $Project) { throw 'STOP: build argument vector is malformed.' }

    $build = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments

    # CENTRAL ruling 13: one internal retry only when the failure signature is
    # a file lock, after a targeted stale-testhost sweep. A second lock is
    # reported as T091_PROCESS_LOCK_RED with the locking details.
    if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $build.Combined -match 'MSB3027|MSB3021|CS2012') {
        Write-Warn2 "$Label hit a file lock; sweeping stale test hosts and retrying once"
        Stop-StaleTestHost -Stage "the $Label retry"
        $build = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments
        if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $build.Combined -match 'MSB3027|MSB3021|CS2012') {
            $lockLine = @($build.Combined -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'locked by|being used by' } | Select-Object -First 3)
            Add-GateResult -Name 'T091_PROCESS_LOCK_RED' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail ($lockLine -join ' | ')
        }
    }

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ("build_" + $Label + ".log")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($log, $build.Combined, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad "compile failed: $Label"

        # W1-PACK-DIAG-03. The old pattern demanded exactly two letters, so
        # MSBuild's own MSB3027 / MSB3021 matched nothing and the pack reported
        # a failure with no reason at all. Compiler codes are CS/NU/xUnit-style,
        # MSBuild codes are MSB: accept any code, and when the filter still
        # matches nothing, show the tail of the log rather than silence.
        $errors = @($build.Combined -split "`n" |
            Where-Object { $_ -match 'error [A-Z]+\d+' } | Select-Object -First 25)

        if ($errors.Count -eq 0) {
            $errors = @($build.Combined -split "`n" |
                Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 } | Select-Object -Last 15)
            Write-Warn2 'no error-coded line matched; showing the end of the build output'
        }

        foreach ($line in $errors) { Write-Host "         $($line.Trim())" }
        Write-Inf "log: $log"
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "compile green: $Label"
    return $true
}

function Invoke-Gate {
    param(
        [string] $Gate,
        [string] $Project,
        [int] $MinimumPassed = 1,
        [hashtable] $Environment = @{}
    )

    Write-Inf "testing $Gate"

    $filter = 'Gate=' + $Gate
    $trxName = 'test_' + ($Gate -replace '[^\w]', '_') + '.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $Project, '--filter', $filter, '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet', '--logger', $trxLogger, '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot)

    # 0 test | 1 project | 2 --filter | 3 filter | 4 --nologo | 5 --no-build
    # 6 -v | 7 quiet | 8 --logger | 9 logger | 10 --results-directory | 11 path
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 12 -or $arguments[3] -ne $filter -or $arguments[9] -ne $trxLogger -or
        $arguments[11] -ne $script:EvidenceRoot) {
        throw "STOP: test argument vector for $Gate is malformed."
    }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments -Environment $Environment

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot ("test_" + ($Gate -replace '[^\w]', '_') + ".log")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($log, $run.Combined, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $summary = [regex]::Match($run.Combined, 'Failed:\s*(?<failed>\d+),\s*Passed:\s*(?<passed>\d+),\s*Skipped:\s*(?<skipped>\d+),\s*Total:\s*(?<total>\d+)')
    if (-not $summary.Success) {
        Write-Bad "$Gate produced no test summary; the run did not execute"
        Write-Inf "log: $log"
        Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'no summary parsed'
        return $false
    }

    $failed = [int] $summary.Groups['failed'].Value
    $passed = [int] $summary.Groups['passed'].Value

    if ($failed -gt 0 -or $passed -lt $MinimumPassed) {
        Write-Bad "$Gate : $failed failed, $passed passed"
        Show-TrxFailures -TrxPath $trxPath
        Write-Inf "log: $log | trx: $trxPath"
        Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "$failed failed, $passed passed"
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "$Gate : $passed passed"
    Add-GateResult -Name $Gate -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$passed passed"
    return $true
}

function Read-TrxFailures {
    param([string] $TrxPath)

    $failures = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TrxPath)) { return @() }

    $trx = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $TrxPath -Raw)
    foreach ($result in @($trx.GetElementsByTagName('UnitTestResult'))) {
        if ($result.outcome -ne 'Failed') { continue }
        $message = ''
        $info = $result.GetElementsByTagName('ErrorInfo')
        if ($info.Count -gt 0) {
            $m = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('Message'))
            if ($m.Count -gt 0) { $message = (($m[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 1).Trim() }
        }
        $null = $failures.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string] $result.testName; Message = $message })
    }

    return @($failures)
}

<#
    W1-PACK-BASELINE-01.

    Regression is judged on the DELTA against the unpatched worktree, not on
    an absolute zero and not on a list of names somebody typed. The parallel
    lanes commit and leave worktree state continuously; a failure that already
    exists before T-091 touches a file is inherited by definition, and a
    failure that appears only after is T-091's by definition. The pack measures
    both and decides from the measurement.
#>
function Invoke-BaselineRegression {
    Write-Inf 'baseline: building the architecture suite against the unpatched worktree'

    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ArchitectureProject -Label 'baseline_architecture_tests')) {
        throw 'STOP: the unpatched worktree does not compile the architecture suite; no baseline can be taken.'
    }

    $trxName = 'regression_baseline.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $script:ArchitectureProject, '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet', '--logger', $trxLogger, '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot)
    if ($arguments.Count -ne 10 -or $arguments[7] -ne $trxLogger) { throw 'STOP: baseline argument vector is malformed.' }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_baseline.log'), $run.Combined,
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    $summary = [regex]::Match($run.Combined, 'Failed:\s*(?<failed>\d+),\s*Passed:\s*(?<passed>\d+)')
    if (-not $summary.Success) { throw 'STOP: the baseline regression produced no summary.' }

    $failures = Read-TrxFailures -TrxPath $trxPath
    $script:BaselineFailures = @{}
    foreach ($failure in $failures) { $script:BaselineFailures[$failure.Name] = $failure.Message }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression_baseline_failures.txt'),
        (($failures | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + ' :: ' + $_.Message }) -join "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    Write-Ok "baseline: $($summary.Groups['passed'].Value) passed, $($failures.Count) failing on the unpatched worktree (recorded)"
    foreach ($failure in $failures) { Write-Inf "  inherited: $($failure.Name)" }
    Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION_BASELINE' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($failures.Count) pre-existing failure(s) recorded"
}

function Show-TrxFailures {
    param([string] $TrxPath)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TrxPath)) {
        Write-Warn2 'no TRX was produced; details limited to the log'
        return
    }

    try {
        $trx = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $TrxPath -Raw)
        foreach ($result in @($trx.GetElementsByTagName('UnitTestResult'))) {
            if ($result.outcome -ne 'Failed') { continue }
            Write-Host "         FAILED  $($result.testName)"
            $info = $result.GetElementsByTagName('ErrorInfo')
            if ($info.Count -eq 0) { continue }

            $message = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('Message'))
            if ($message.Count -gt 0) {
                foreach ($line in @(($message[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 60)) {
                    Write-Host "           $($line.TrimEnd())"
                }
            }

            $stack = @($info[0].GetElementsByTagName('StackTrace'))
            if ($stack.Count -gt 0) {
                foreach ($line in @(($stack[0].InnerText -split "`n") | Select-Object -First 4)) {
                    Write-Host "           $($line.Trim())"
                }
            }
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Warn2 "could not parse the TRX: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Invoke-SharedDatabaseUpgrade {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 8 - SHARED DATABASE UPGRADE (ppiq_app) - after 15/15'
    Write-Inf "target: $($script:PgHost):$($script:PgPort)/$($script:PgDatabase) as $($script:PgUser)"
    $state = Get-SharedDatabaseState
    Write-Inf "ppiq_app state before 834: $state"

    $sql = Get-Payload -Key 'sql.834'
    $script:DbPhase = 'FAILED_DURING_PPIQ_APP_UPGRADE'

    $first = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:PgDatabase -Sql $sql -StopOnError
    if ($first.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad '834 failed on ppiq_app'
        Write-Host ($first.Combined -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ERROR|DETAIL|LINE|HINT' } | Select-Object -First 12 | Out-String)
        Add-GateResult -Name 'PPIQ_APP_834' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'see server error above'
        return $false
    }
    Add-GateResult -Name 'PPIQ_APP_834' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    # Idempotence on the shared database too: the second application must be
    # a no-op, and the semantic grammar must not have been duplicated.
    $second = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:PgDatabase -Sql $sql -StopOnError
    if ($second.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'PPIQ_APP_834_IDEMPOTENT' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'second application failed'
        return $false
    }

    $probe = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:PgDatabase -StopOnError -Sql @"
\pset tuples_only on
\pset format unaligned
SELECT 'KINDS:' || count(*) FROM ppiq_meta.signal_kinds;
SELECT 'AGGS:' || count(*) FROM ppiq_meta.aggregation_kinds;
SELECT 'FN:' || count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'resolve_aggregation_semantics';
SELECT 'COL:' || count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta' AND table_name = 'parameter_definitions' AND column_name = 'sampling_basis';
"@
    $lines = @($probe.StdOut -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })
    $kinds = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'KINDS:*' }) -replace 'KINDS:', '')
    $aggs  = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'AGGS:*' }) -replace 'AGGS:', '')
    $fn    = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'FN:*' }) -replace 'FN:', '')
    $col   = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'COL:*' }) -replace 'COL:', '')

    if ($kinds -ne 10 -or $aggs -ne 11 -or $fn -ne 1 -or $col -ne 1) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'PPIQ_APP_834_IDEMPOTENT' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "kinds=$kinds aggs=$aggs fn=$fn sampling_basis=$col"
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "834 idempotent on ppiq_app: 10 signal kinds, 11 aggregation kinds, resolver present, sampling_basis present"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'PPIQ_APP_834_IDEMPOTENT' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    if (-not (Test-ResolverExecutes -Database $script:PgDatabase -Label 'PPIQ_APP')) { return $false }
    $script:DbPhase = 'PPIQ_APP_UPGRADED'
    return $true
}

function Invoke-FreshReplay {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 5 - FRESH DISPOSABLE CANONICAL REPLAY'
    $script:DbPhase = 'FAILED_DISPOSABLE_DB_ONLY'
    New-DisposableDatabase

    if (-not (Invoke-CanonicalReplay -Database $script:ProbeDatabase)) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'FRESH_REPLAY' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'see failing script above'
        Remove-DisposableDatabase
        return $false
    }

    # 834 is on the path and has just run once; running it a second time on
    # the same database is the idempotence proof for a fresh install.
    $again = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:ProbeDatabase -Sql (Get-Payload -Key 'sql.834') -StopOnError
    if ($again.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad 'second application of 834 on the fresh database failed'
        Write-Host ($again.Combined -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ERROR|DETAIL|LINE' } | Select-Object -First 12 | Out-String)
        Add-GateResult -Name 'FRESH_REPLAY' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail '834 not idempotent on a fresh database'
        Remove-DisposableDatabase
        return $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-ResolverExecutes -Database $script:ProbeDatabase -Label 'PROBE')) {
        return $false
    }

    # The probe stays alive: T-210 acceptance runs against it, never against
    # ppiq_app, which is upgraded only after 15/15 GREEN (CENTRAL ruling 13).
    Add-GateResult -Name 'FRESH_REPLAY' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail '102 script(s) then 834 again; resolver executes'
    return $true
}

function Get-SharedDatabaseState {
    # CENTRAL ruling 15: the failed r1 applied its 834 to ppiq_app and rollback
    # never undoes a database. Classify the shared state exactly; anything but
    # the three known shapes is drift to stop on.
    $probe = Invoke-Psql -Database $script:PgDatabase -StopOnError -Sql @"
\pset tuples_only on
\pset format unaligned
SELECT 'SEM:' || count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta' AND table_name = 'parameter_definitions' AND column_name = 'signal_kind';
SELECT 'TEN:' || count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta' AND table_name = 'parameter_definitions' AND column_name = 'tenant_id';
SELECT 'FK:' || count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_parameter_definitions_tenant';
"@
    if ($probe.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: could not classify ppiq_app: $($probe.StdErr)" }
    $lines = @($probe.StdOut -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })
    $sem = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'SEM:*' }) -replace 'SEM:', '')
    $ten = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'TEN:*' }) -replace 'TEN:', '')
    $fk  = [int](($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like 'FK:*' }) -replace 'FK:', '')

    if ($sem -eq 0 -and $ten -eq 0) { return 'A_PRE_T210' }
    if ($sem -eq 1 -and $ten -eq 0) { return 'B_R1_FOOTPRINT' }
    if ($sem -eq 1 -and $ten -eq 1 -and $fk -eq 1) { return 'C_R2_CONVERGED' }
    throw "STOP: ppiq_app is in an unrecognised partial T-210 state (signal_kind=$sem tenant_id=$ten fk=$fk); refusing to guess."
}

function Invoke-AcceptanceMatrix {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 6 - T-210 ACCEPTANCE ON THE PROBE'
    Write-Host "  T-210 acceptance DB = $($script:ProbeDatabase)"

    $environment = @{
        'PPIQ_TEST_PGHOST' = $script:PgHost
        'PPIQ_TEST_PGPORT' = $script:PgPort
        'PPIQ_TEST_PGUSER' = $script:PgUser
        'PPIQ_TEST_PGPASSWORD' = $script:PgPassword
        'PPIQ_TEST_PGDATABASE' = $script:ProbeDatabase
        'PPIQ_T210_TEST_DATABASE' = $script:ProbeDatabase
    }

    # The canary first. Red here stops everything with the offending column
    # printed once (CENTRAL ruling 11).
    if (-not (Invoke-Gate -Gate 'T210-FIXTURE-00' -Project $script:IntegrationProject -Environment $environment)) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  ACCEPTANCE: stopped at T210-FIXTURE-00 (prerequisite)' -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    $gates = @(
        'T210-07', 'T210-08', 'T210-11',
        'T210-01', 'T210-02', 'T210-03', 'T210-04', 'T210-05', 'T210-06',
        'T210-09', 'T210-10', 'T210-12', 'T210-13', 'T210-14', 'T210-15')

    $green = 0
    foreach ($gate in $gates) {
        if (Invoke-Gate -Gate $gate -Project $script:IntegrationProject -Environment $environment) { $green++ }
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "  ACCEPTANCE: $green/15 GREEN" -ForegroundColor $(if ($green -eq 15) { 'Green' } else { 'Red' })
    return ($green -eq 15)
}

function Test-ResolverExecutes {
    param([string] $Database, [string] $Label)

    # plpgsql binds column references at EXECUTION, not at CREATE FUNCTION. A
    # resolver that names a column the table does not have passes every replay
    # and fails on first use. Calling it with random identities must yield an
    # AG01 row - not an exception - on every database it was applied to.
    $probe = Invoke-Psql -Database $Database -StopOnError -Sql @"
\pset tuples_only on
\pset format unaligned
SELECT 'REFUSAL:' || COALESCE(refusal_code, 'none') FROM ppiq_meta.resolve_aggregation_semantics(gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), NULL, NULL);
"@
    if ($probe.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad "resolver does not execute on $Label"
        Write-Host ($probe.Combined -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ERROR|DETAIL|LINE|HINT|CONTEXT' } | Select-Object -First 10 | Out-String)
        Add-GateResult -Name "RESOLVER_EXECUTES_$Label" -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'see server error above'
        return $false
    }

    $line = @($probe.StdOut -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -like 'REFUSAL:*' })
    if ($line.Count -ne 1 -or $line[0] -ne 'REFUSAL:AG01') {
        Add-GateResult -Name "RESOLVER_EXECUTES_$Label" -Verdict 'RED' -Detail ("unexpected: " + ($line -join ' '))
        return $false
    }

    Write-Ok "resolver executes on $Label and refuses an unknown parameter with AG01"
    Add-GateResult -Name "RESOLVER_EXECUTES_$Label" -Verdict 'GREEN'
    return $true
}

function Invoke-MigrationArchitectureGate {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 7 - MIGRATION ARCHITECTURE (must be GREEN after normalisation)'

    # CENTRAL ruling 14: these two were inherited red at baseline. T-210 edits
    # the same authority and has normalised them, so they must be GREEN now -
    # not carried as inherited. Nine tests, all required.
    return (Invoke-Gate -Gate 'CanonicalMigrationOrder' -Project $script:ArchitectureProject -MinimumPassed 9)
}

function Invoke-Regression {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 9 - REGRESSION'

    # CENTRAL correction:
    # Windows PowerShell 5.1 collapses a pipeline yielding one object to a scalar.
    # Every collection used below is explicitly materialised with @(...), so .Count
    # is valid for zero, one and many results.
    #
    # T-210 intentionally fixes the two inherited CanonicalMigrationOrder failures.
    # The only unrelated inherited failure expected after T-210 is the stale T-087
    # JobLog guard. Any other failed identity is a T-210 regression and blocks commit.

    $trxName = 'regression.central.trx'
    $trxPath = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot $trxName
    $trxLogger = 'trx;LogFileName=' + $trxName

    $arguments = @(
        'test', $script:ArchitectureProject,
        '--nologo', '--no-build',
        '-v', 'quiet',
        '--logger', $trxLogger,
        '--results-directory', $script:EvidenceRoot
    )

    if (@($arguments).Count -ne 10) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'malformed argument vector'
        return $false
    }

    $run = Invoke-Native -FilePath 'dotnet' -Arguments $arguments

    $log = Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression.central.log'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $log,
        [string]$run.Combined,
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trxPath -PathType Leaf)) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'TRX missing'
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] regression TRX missing: $trxPath" -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    [xml]$trx = Get-Content -LiteralPath $trxPath -Raw

    $allResults = @(
        $trx.SelectNodes("//*[local-name()='UnitTestResult']")
    )
    if ($allResults.Count -eq 0) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail 'zero tests in TRX'
        Write-Host '  [FAIL] regression was vacuous: zero UnitTestResult nodes' -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    $failedResults = @(
        $allResults | Where-Object {
            $_.GetAttribute('outcome') -eq 'Failed'
        }
    )
    $passedResults = @(
        $allResults | Where-Object {
            $_.GetAttribute('outcome') -eq 'Passed'
        }
    )
    $otherResults = @(
        $allResults | Where-Object {
            $o = $_.GetAttribute('outcome')
            $o -ne 'Passed' -and $o -ne 'Failed'
        }
    )

    # The untouched baseline in THIS anchored run was 262 passed + 3 failed = 265.
    # T-210 owns and fixes the two CanonicalMigrationOrder failures, so discovery
    # must remain 265 and the post-change failure set must contain no new identity.
    if ($allResults.Count -ne 265) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "discovery drift: $($allResults.Count) vs baseline 265"
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] regression discovery drift: expected 265, actual $($allResults.Count)" -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    if ($otherResults.Count -ne 0) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "$($otherResults.Count) non Passed/Failed result(s)"
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] unexpected regression outcomes: $($otherResults.Count)" -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    $failureDetails = @()
    foreach ($result in $failedResults) {
        $name = [string]$result.GetAttribute('testName')
        $message = ''

        $errorInfo = @($result.SelectNodes(".//*[local-name()='ErrorInfo']"))
        if ($errorInfo.Count -gt 0) {
            $messageNodes = @($errorInfo[0].SelectNodes("./*[local-name()='Message']"))
            if ($messageNodes.Count -gt 0) {
                $message = @(
                    $messageNodes[0].InnerText -split "`r?`n"
                )[0].Trim()
            }
        }

        $failureDetails += [pscustomobject]@{
            Name    = $name
            Message = $message
        }
    }

    $jobLogSuffix = 'JobLogObservabilitySourceGuardTests.Job_log_service_and_filter_exist'

    $inherited = @(
        $failureDetails | Where-Object {
            $_.Name.EndsWith($jobLogSuffix, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
        }
    )

    $introduced = @(
        $failureDetails | Where-Object {
            -not $_.Name.EndsWith($jobLogSuffix, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
        }
    )

    foreach ($failure in $inherited) {
        Write-Host "  [WARN] INHERITED (baseline-proven, not T-210 owned): $($failure.Name)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($failure.Message)) {
            Write-Host "         $($failure.Message)"
        }
    }

    foreach ($failure in $introduced) {
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] INTRODUCED: $($failure.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($failure.Message)) {
            Write-Host "         $($failure.Message)"
        }
    }

    $evidence = [pscustomobject]@{
        total                  = $allResults.Count
        passed                 = $passedResults.Count
        failed                 = $failedResults.Count
        inherited              = @($inherited | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        introduced             = @($introduced | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        baselineFailed         = 3
        baselinePassed         = 262
        fixedByT210Manifest    = @(
            'CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.Every_script_on_the_path_still_matches_its_recorded_hash',
            'CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.Views_apply_after_every_schema_script'
        )
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Join-Path $script:EvidenceRoot 'regression.central.json'),
        ($evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    # Exact anchored expectation: the unrelated JobLog guard remains the one
    # inherited failure; T-210 fixes the two migration-order baseline failures.
    if ($introduced.Count -gt 0) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "$($introduced.Count) introduced; $($inherited.Count) inherited"
        Write-Host "  [INFO] regression evidence: $log | $trxPath" -ForegroundColor Gray
        return $false
    }

    if ($inherited.Count -ne 1 -or $failedResults.Count -ne 1) {
        Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'RED' -Detail "unexpected failure-set shape: $($failedResults.Count) failed / $($inherited.Count) inherited"
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] expected exactly the one baseline-proven JobLog failure after T-210" -ForegroundColor Red
        return $false
    }

    $script:RegressionWaived = @($inherited | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })

    Add-GateResult -Name 'REGRESSION' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($passedResults.Count) passed; 1 inherited baseline failure; 0 introduced; 2 baseline manifest failures resolved"
    Write-Host "  [OK] REGRESSION GREEN - 0 introduced; 1 inherited; 2 baseline migration failures resolved" -ForegroundColor Green
    return $true
}

# ------------------------------------------------------ ownership & commit ---

function Invoke-OwnershipGateAndCommit {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 6 - OWNERSHIP GATE AND COMMIT'

    # EXACT FILES ONLY. Never git add -A: this repository carries 100+ foreign
    # worktree entries belonging to other lanes, and a broad add would commit
    # someone else's unfinished work under this task's message.
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) {
        $add = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $entry.Path)
        if ($add.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: could not stage $($entry.Path): $($add.StdErr)" }
    }

    # W1-PACK-CRLF-01. git prints LF; the capture appends CRLF; a path split on
    # LF alone keeps its trailing CR and never equals the manifest path. The
    # last run refused its own fifteen files on exactly that character.
    $staged = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })
    $owned = @{}
    foreach ($entry in $script:Manifest) { $owned[$entry.Path] = $true }

    $foreignStaged = @($staged | Where-Object { -not $owned.ContainsKey($_) })
    if ($foreignStaged.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "STOP: the index contains path(s) this task does not own: " + ($foreignStaged -join ', ')
    }

    foreach ($path in $staged) { Write-Inf "staged $path" }
    Write-Ok "$($staged.Count) owned path(s) staged, nothing foreign"
    Add-GateResult -Name 'OWNERSHIP' -Verdict 'GREEN' -Detail "$($staged.Count) owned path(s) staged"

    $message = 'Add canonical signal and aggregation semantics authority'
    $commit = Invoke-Git @('commit', '-m', $message)
    if ($commit.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "STOP: commit failed: $($commit.Combined)" }

    $script:CommitSha = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    Write-Ok "committed $script:CommitSha"
}

function Write-ClosureProof {
    Write-Section 'PHASE 7 - POST-COMMIT PROOF'

    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).StdOut.Trim()
    $files = (Invoke-Git @('show', '--stat', '--name-only', '--pretty=format:', 'HEAD')).StdOut
    $index = @((Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).StdOut -split "`n" |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all')
    $foreignAfter = @($status.StdOut -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "  parent HEAD       : $($script:ObservedHead)"
    Write-Host "  HEAD              : $head"
    Write-Host "  commit            : $($script:CommitSha)"
    Write-Host "  index after commit: $($index.Count) path(s)"
    Write-Host "  foreign entries   : before $($script:ForeignBefore.Count) / after $($foreignAfter.Count)"
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  COMMITTED PATHS'
    foreach ($line in ($files -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })) { Write-Host "    $line" }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  GATE RESULTS'
    foreach ($gate in $script:GateResults) {
        $mark = if ($gate.Verdict -eq 'GREEN') { ' ' } else { '!' }
        Write-Host ("   $mark {0,-34} {1} {2}" -f $gate.Gate, $gate.Verdict, $gate.Detail)
    }

    if (@($script:RegressionInherited).Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  INHERITED REGRESSION FAILURES (identical on the unpatched worktree; recorded, not fixed)'
        foreach ($name in $script:RegressionInherited) { Write-Host "    $name" }
    }

    if (@($script:RegressionWaived).Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host '  REGRESSION FAILURES WAIVED BY OPERATOR AUTHORITY'
        foreach ($name in $script:RegressionWaived) { Write-Host "    $name" }
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  T-210 SCOPE STATEMENT'
    Write-Host '    migration 834 extends parameter_definitions and kpi_parameter_bindings; no second registry.'
    Write-Host '    resolution: KPI binding override -> parameter aggregation_kind -> AG01; compatibility -> AG02.'
    Write-Host '    inherited predecessor manifest bookkeeping normalised while extending the same canonical authority.'
    Write-Host "    database phase: $($script:DbPhase)"

    $red = @($script:GateResults | Where-Object { $_.Verdict -ne 'GREEN' })
    Write-Host ''

    if ($red.Count -eq 0 -and $index.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host '  T-210 CLOSED GREEN' -ForegroundColor Green
        return $true
    }

    Write-Host "  T-210 NOT CLOSED - $($red.Count) gate(s) red" -ForegroundColor Red
    return $false
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- main ----

Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'PPIQ T-210 - Canonical signal and aggregation semantics authority'
Write-Host 'migration 834 on parameter_definitions + kpi_parameter_bindings; single resolver; no silent Average'

$script:ObservedHead = ''
$exitCode = 1

try {
    Invoke-Preflight
    Test-Payloads
    Invoke-Apply

    Write-Section 'PHASE 3 - COMPILE'
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ApiProject -Label 'api')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:IntegrationProject -Label 'integration_tests')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Build -Project $script:ArchitectureProject -Label 'architecture_tests')) { throw 'COMPILE_RED' }
    Add-GateResult -Name 'COMPILE' -Verdict 'GREEN'

    # Risk first (CENTRAL ruling 16): prove the migration on a fresh database
    # before the shared database is touched, then upgrade ppiq_app, then run
    # the semantic gates against it, then prove the manifest tests are green.
    if (-not (Invoke-FreshReplay)) { Remove-DisposableDatabase; throw 'FRESH_REPLAY_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-AcceptanceMatrix)) { Remove-DisposableDatabase; throw 'ACCEPTANCE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-MigrationArchitectureGate)) { Remove-DisposableDatabase; throw 'MIGRATION_ARCHITECTURE_RED' }
    Remove-DisposableDatabase
    $script:DbPhase = 'BEFORE_DB_MUTATION'

    if (-not (Invoke-SharedDatabaseUpgrade)) { throw 'PPIQ_APP_UPGRADE_RED' }
    if (-not (Invoke-Regression)) { throw 'REGRESSION_RED' }

    Invoke-OwnershipGateAndCommit

    if (Write-ClosureProof) { $exitCode = 0 }
}
catch {
    $reason = $_.Exception.Message

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad "T-210 stopped: $reason"

    if ($script:CommitSha -eq '') {
        # Clear anything this run staged BEFORE the rollback compares worktree
        # counts, so the comparison measures the worktree and not the index.
        $reset = Invoke-Git @('reset')
        if ($reset.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Warn2 'could not clear the index; inspect git status before rerunning' }

        Restore-OwnedSource -Reason $reason
    }
    else {
        Write-Warn2 'the commit already landed; source was NOT rolled back'
    }
    Write-Warn2 "database phase at failure: $($script:DbPhase) (database changes are never undone by rollback)"

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  GATE RESULTS'
    foreach ($gate in $script:GateResults) {
        $mark = if ($gate.Verdict -eq 'GREEN') { ' ' } else { '!' }
        Write-Host ("   $mark {0,-34} {1} {2}" -f $gate.Gate, $gate.Verdict, $gate.Detail)
    }

    $exitCode = 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host "  evidence: $script:EvidenceRoot"
exit $exitCode

[FILE_END]

    Establishes the governed output identity as hashed canonical content and as
    a catalogue-validated value, so the frontend pack has an authority to bind

      gate       -> dotnet build of the solution
      revert     -> automatic and complete on any failure after backup

    public const string RepresentationGraph = "graph";

'@ @'
    public const string RepresentationGraph = "graph";
    public const string RepresentationSql = "sql";

    /// <summary>
    /// T-253. THE GOVERNED OUTPUT TARGET, AT THE ROOT OF THE CONTENT.
    ///
    /// It sits beside the representation rather than inside it, so one reader can answer
    /// "what does this definition write to" without first asking whether it is a graph or
    /// a statement. It is hashed with everything else: a definition that changes its
    /// output identity IS a different definition and the writer has to see that.
    ///
    /// The value is a CANONICAL ENTITY NAME from ICanonicalEntityCatalog. Never a
    /// physical relation, never a customer table, never a page's idea of context.
    /// </summary>
    public const string RootOutputTarget = "outputTarget";

    /// <summary>
    /// The pre-T-253 graph-local field. Retained because T-242 history is full of it and
    /// those versions must stay reopenable. It is no longer the authority.
    /// </summary>
    public const string GraphTargetEntity = "targetEntity";

Add-Edit $Content "content: ForGraph" @'
    /// <summary>Content for a graph-authored definition.</summary>
    public static string ForGraph(string graphJson)
    {
        var graph = ParseObject(graphJson, "graph");

        var root = new JsonObject
        {
            ["graph"] = Canonicalise(graph),
            ["representation"] = RepresentationGraph,
        };

        return Serialise(root);
    }
'@ @'
    /// <summary>
    /// Content for a graph-authored definition.
    ///
    /// T-253. The root output target is REQUIRED, and where the graph still carries its
    /// own targetEntity the two must agree. Disagreement is refused rather than resolved
    /// by precedence: a rule that silently preferred one of two contradicting identities
    /// would make the losing one a lie the store then keeps forever.
    /// </summary>
    public static string ForGraph(string graphJson, string outputTarget)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outputTarget))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "A governed output target is required. It is never defaulted.", nameof(outputTarget));
        }

        var graph = ParseObject(graphJson, "graph");
        var declared = TrimmedOrNull(graph[GraphTargetEntity]);
        var target = outputTarget.Trim();

        if (declared is not null && !string.Equals(declared, target, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "The graph names '" + declared + "' as its target entity while the governed output target is '"
                + target + "'. One definition cannot carry two output identities.",
                nameof(outputTarget));
        }

        var root = new JsonObject
        {
            ["graph"] = Canonicalise(graph),
            [RootOutputTarget] = target,
            ["representation"] = RepresentationGraph,
        };

        return Serialise(root);
    }
'@

Add-Edit $Content "content: helpers" @'
    private static JsonObject ParseObject(string json, string what)
'@ @'
    /// <summary>
    /// T-253. The one place a stored target string becomes a value or a null. An empty
    /// or whitespace string is NOT a target named "", it is the absence of one, and the
    /// pre-T-253 graph fixtures in this repository contain exactly that.
    /// </summary>
    public static string? TrimmedOrNull(JsonNode? node)
    {
        if (node is null) { return null; }

        string? raw;
        try
        {
            raw = node.GetValue<string>();
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException)
        {
            // A non-string in a name position is not a name. The caller refuses on null
            // rather than stringifying whatever was there.
            return null;
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw) ? null : raw.Trim();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// T-253. The target entity a graph payload declares, or null. Callers that hold a
    /// graph but not yet its content use this to state the target explicitly instead of
    /// letting a default appear somewhere downstream.
    /// </summary>
    public static string? TryReadGraphTargetEntity(string graphJson)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(graphJson)) { return null; }

        JsonNode? node;
        try
        {
            node = JsonNode.Parse(graphJson);
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return node is JsonObject obj ? TrimmedOrNull(obj[GraphTargetEntity]) : null;
    }

    private static JsonObject ParseObject(string json, string what)

Add-Edit $Service "service: typed refusal helpers" @'
    private static ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion> Refuse(string message) =>
        ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion>.Failure(ApplicationError.Validation(message));
'@ @'
    private static ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion> Refuse(string message) =>
        ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion>.Failure(ApplicationError.Validation(message));

    private static ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion> RefuseTyped(string code, string message) =>
        ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion>.Failure(ApplicationError.Validation(
            message,
            new Dictionary<string, string[]>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            {
                ["errorCode"] = new[] { code },
            }));

    /// <summary>
    /// T-253. The governed output target, or a typed refusal. Null means it is good.
    ///
    /// The catalogue is the authority and it reads the mapped model, so this refuses a
    /// name the product cannot resolve rather than storing a string nobody can act on.
    /// It never substitutes a default, and it never falls back to a physical relation.
    /// </summary>
    private ApplicationResult<CanvasDefinitionVersion>? RefuseTargetOrNull(string? outputTarget)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outputTarget))
        {
            return RefuseTyped(
                TargetRequiredCode,
                "This definition has no governed output target. Choose one before saving; it is never defaulted.");
        }

        var target = outputTarget.Trim();
        if (_canonicalEntities.FindType(target) is null)
        {
            return RefuseTyped(
                TargetNotCanonicalCode,
                "'" + target + "' is not a canonical entity in this model, so it cannot be a governed output target.");
        }

        return null;
    }

using System.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Npgsql;
using PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Methods;
using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace PlantProcess.Api.Endpoints.Prep;

/// <summary>
/// PREREQUISITES for M1-19 (SQL editor) and M1-20 (method palette).
///
/// M1-19. The safe-SQL validator ALREADY EXISTS as
/// public.ppiq_resolve_safe_sql(text, integer, integer) and already enforces
/// every control Authoring Layer Specification 12.1 requires: SELECT/WITH only,
/// no write/DDL/control statement, no forbidden function, exactly one
/// statement, no CROSS JOIN, a clamped row ceiling and a clamped statement
/// timeout - and it EXPLAINs the statement against the real schema so an
/// unknown view or column is refused BY NAME rather than at run time.
///
/// What it does not do is return rows. It validates. So the editor's "Run and
/// see what came back" needs one endpoint that calls the validator FIRST and
/// executes only on its approval. That is this file. Nothing bypasses the
/// validator, which is the whole constraint the task states.
///
/// It is exposed here rather than reused where it already sits, because the
/// existing caller is mounted under /admin/p03p04/completion behind the data
/// manager policy. That route carries a phase token, which Chapter B.10 forbids,
/// and an authoring surface must not require an administrative role.
///
/// M1-20. The method catalogue also already exists, as
/// PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Methods.AnalysisMethod plus MethodSelector,
/// which chooses deterministically by variable-pair shape and records WHY.
/// Five methods are implemented. What does not exist is a way for a client to
/// ASK what they are, so the palette has nothing to populate from. This
/// projects the catalogue over HTTP.
///
/// HONEST LIMIT, and it is the difference between this and the acceptance
/// criterion: this endpoint reads a C# enum. Adding a method still means
/// editing code, so "adding a method to the registry makes it appear in the
/// palette with no code change" is NOT yet satisfied. It is satisfied when the
/// enum is replaced by ml_method_definitions and this handler reads that table
/// instead - at which point the client contract below does not change, which is
/// the point of shipping the contract first.
/// </summary>
public static class AuthoringSupportEndpoints
{
    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapAuthoringSupportEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)
    {
        var sql = app.MapGroup("/api/prep/sql")
            .WithTags("Prep - SQL authoring")
            .RequireAuthorization();

        sql.MapPost("/run", RunAsync);
        // M1-19: both modes produce the same artifact class - a named, versioned,
        // saved definition. This is the SQL body of that artifact.
        sql.MapPost("/versions", SaveSqlVersionAsync);

        // The group carries the parent path and the child carries the leaf.
        // MapGroup("/api/analysis/methods") + MapGet("/") builds the pattern
        // "/api/analysis/methods/" WITH a trailing slash, which a GET to
        // "/api/analysis/methods" does not match. That is a 404 that looks
        // like a missing endpoint and is a routing mistake.
        var analysis = app.MapGroup("/api/analysis")
            .WithTags("Analysis - method catalogue")
            .RequireAuthorization();

        analysis.MapGet("/methods", GetMethods);

        return app;
    }

    public sealed record RunSqlRequest(string? Sql, int? RowLimit, int? TimeoutMs);

    /// <summary>
    /// Mirrors DryRunResult on the wire so the debug log and the preview table
    /// need no new branch: status, rowCount, columns, rows, message.
    /// </summary>
    // T-036. The returned column list gains its DATABASE TYPE, taken from the
    // reader's own metadata. The browser must never infer a SQL type from a
    // sample JavaScript value - "3" is a text column as often as it is an
    // integer one, and guessing would put a wrong type in front of an engineer
    // deciding whether a column can be joined.
    public sealed record AuthoredColumn(string Name, string DatabaseType);

    public sealed record RunSqlResponse(
        string Status,
        int RowCount,
        IReadOnlyList<string> Columns,
        IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<object?>> Rows,
        string Message,
        string? ErrorCode,
        string? Sql,
        int AppliedRowLimit,
        // Defaulted so the refusal and failure paths - which have no columns to
        // describe - are untouched, and no existing caller of Columns breaks.
        IReadOnlyList<AuthoredColumn>? ColumnDetails = null);

    private static async Task<IResult> RunAsync(
        [FromBody] RunSqlRequest request,
        [FromServices] PlantProcessDbContext db,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var statement = request.Sql ?? string.Empty;
        var rowLimit = request.RowLimit ?? 100;
        var timeoutMs = request.TimeoutMs ?? 3000;

        // STEP 1 - the existing validator. Never skipped, never inlined here,
        // never re-implemented: a second implementation of a governance rule is
        // exactly what Constitution II.7.6 forbids.
        var conn = db.Database.GetDbConnection();
        if (conn.State != ConnectionState.Open) { await conn.OpenAsync(ct); }

        bool isValid = false;
        string errorCode = "Unknown";
        string message = "The validator returned no verdict.";
        string normalized = statement;
        int appliedLimit = rowLimit;

        await using (var check = conn.CreateCommand())
        {
            check.CommandText =
                "SELECT is_valid, error_code, message, normalized_sql, applied_row_limit " +
                "FROM public.ppiq_resolve_safe_sql(@sql, @rowLimit, @timeoutMs);";
            check.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("sql", statement));
            check.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("rowLimit", rowLimit));
            check.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("timeoutMs", timeoutMs));

            await using var reader = await check.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);
            if (await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
            {
                isValid = !reader.IsDBNull(0) && reader.GetBoolean(0);
                errorCode = reader.IsDBNull(1) ? "Unknown" : reader.GetString(1);
                message = reader.IsDBNull(2) ? message : reader.GetString(2);
                normalized = reader.IsDBNull(3) ? statement : reader.GetString(3);
                appliedLimit = reader.IsDBNull(4) ? rowLimit : reader.GetInt32(4);
            }
        }

        if (!isValid)
        {
            // Refused BY NAME. "Invalid query" is not acceptable output from a
            // product that sells honesty - the validator's own error code and
            // sentence are carried through untouched.
            return Results.Ok(new RunSqlResponse(
                Status: "rejected_by_safe_sql",
                RowCount: 0,
                Columns: Array.Empty<string>(),
                Rows: Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<object?>>(),
                Message: message,
                ErrorCode: errorCode,
                Sql: normalized,
                AppliedRowLimit: appliedLimit));
        }

        // STEP 2 - execute, only now, and only what the validator normalised.
        // The ceiling is re-applied by the server regardless of any LIMIT the
        // author wrote, per Specification 12.1.
        var columns = new List<string>();
        var columnDetails = new List<AuthoredColumn>();
        var rows = new List<IReadOnlyList<object?>>();

        try
        {
            await using var exec = conn.CreateCommand();
            exec.CommandText =
                $"SET LOCAL statement_timeout = {Math.Clamp(timeoutMs, 250, 10000)}; " +
                $"SELECT * FROM ({normalized}) __ppiq_authored LIMIT {appliedLimit};";
            await using var reader = await exec.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);

            for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                columns.Add(reader.GetName(i));
                columnDetails.Add(new AuthoredColumn(reader.GetName(i), reader.GetDataTypeName(i)));
            }

            while (await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
            {
                var row = new object?[reader.FieldCount];
                for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
                {
                    row[i] = reader.IsDBNull(i) ? null : reader.GetValue(i);
                }
                rows.Add(row);
            }
        }
        catch (PostgresException ex)
        {
            // The validator passed it and the database still refused. Say which,
            // and say that it got past validation - that distinction is what
            // tells an engineer whether to change the SQL or report a defect.
            //
            // T-036 HOTFIX. This used to append the database's own text, which
            // is the same raw-exception leak T-035 closed on the dry-run path.
            // The sentence comes from the mechanism T-035 already established -
            // reused, not re-implemented, because a second sanitiser is a second
            // place for the rule to drift.
            return Results.Ok(new RunSqlResponse(
                Status: "failed",
                RowCount: 0,
                Columns: Array.Empty<string>(),
                Rows: Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<object?>>(),
                Message: "The statement passed validation and then failed when it ran. "
                    + VisualMapperEndpoints.SafeDatabaseMessage(ex),
                ErrorCode: ex.SqlState,
                Sql: normalized,
                AppliedRowLimit: appliedLimit));
        }

        return Results.Ok(new RunSqlResponse(
            Status: "succeeded",
            RowCount: rows.Count,
            Columns: columns,
            Rows: rows,
            Message: message,
            ErrorCode: null,
            Sql: normalized,
            AppliedRowLimit: appliedLimit,
            ColumnDetails: columnDetails));
    }

    // ================================================================== M1-19
    // Saving an authored statement as an immutable version.
    //
    // WHY THIS EXISTS. The dual-mode contract says both modes produce the same
    // artifact class: a named, versioned, saved definition. This path writes
    // ppiq_mapping_versions - version_number, a jsonb definition and a status -
    // which the 21-Jul matrix found matches the specification's immutability
    // rule verbatim.
    //
    // CORRECTED BY T-039. An earlier version of this comment said the GRAPH
    // path already used this table. It does not: the board publish path writes
    // ppiq_visual_mapper_versions, keyed by session_id, while this table is
    // keyed by mapping_code. The code here was always right; the sentence was
    // stale. The two stores therefore carry DIFFERENT identity semantics, which
    // is why T-039 refused to adapt the Transformation kind behind
    // IDefinitionService and left that convergence to M2a.
    //
    // THE FORKED GRAPH TRAVELS WITH IT. When a user forks a visual definition
    // into SQL authoring, the graph is detached - but detached is not deleted.
    // It is stored inside the definition jsonb under forkedFromGraph, so the
    // acceptance line "the graph is still retrievable afterwards" is satisfied
    // by the artifact itself and not by asking the user to remember.
    //
    // NOTHING UNVALIDATED IS EVER STORED. The statement is put through
    // ppiq_resolve_safe_sql before the insert. A definition that could not run
    // is not a definition, and storing one would mean a published version that
    // fails the first time somebody opens it.

    public sealed record SaveSqlVersionRequest(
        string? Code,
        string? DisplayName,
        string? CanonicalEntity,
        string? Sql,
        System.Text.Json.JsonElement? ForkedFromGraph);

    public sealed record SaveSqlVersionResponse(
        bool Saved, int VersionNumber, string? Id, string Message, string? ErrorCode);

    private static async Task<IResult> SaveSqlVersionAsync(
        [FromBody] SaveSqlVersionRequest request,
        System.Security.Claims.ClaimsPrincipal user,
        [FromServices] PlantProcess.Application.Definitions.ICanonicalIdentityResolver identity,
        [FromServices] PlantProcess.Application.Definitions.Canvas.ICanvasDefinitionLifecycle lifecycle,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // T-244. CONVERGED ONTO THE CANONICAL DEFINITION LIFECYCLE.
        //
        // The route, request and response shapes are unchanged so an existing
        // client is still a valid client. What changed is the authority: the
        // save creates a canonical Transformation draft and the publish moves
        // it through the writer's publish semantics, with the legacy
        // ppiq_mapping_versions row written as a compatibility projection
        // inside the same transaction as the canonical publish. The deferral
        // recorded above - "left that convergence to M2a" - is closed here.
        //
        // Nothing unvalidated is stored: the lifecycle service puts the
        // statement through the same ppiq_resolve_safe_sql before any write.
        var code = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Code) ? "sql_definition" : request.Code!.Trim();

        var resolved = await CanvasDefinitionEndpoints.ResolveIdentityAsync(user, identity, ct);
        if (resolved is null)
        {
            return Results.Forbid();
        }

        var saved = await lifecycle.SaveSqlAsync(
            new PlantProcess.Application.Definitions.Canvas.CanvasSqlSave(
                resolved.Value.TenantId,
                resolved.Value.OwnerId,
                code,
                request.DisplayName ?? code,
                request.CanonicalEntity,
                request.Sql ?? string.Empty,
                request.ForkedFromGraph?.GetRawText()),
            ct);

        if (saved.IsFailure)
        {
            var errorCode = saved.Error!.Details is { } details && details.TryGetValue("errorCode", out var codes) && codes.Length > 0
                ? codes[0]
                : saved.Error.Code;
            return Results.Ok(new SaveSqlVersionResponse(false, 0, null, saved.Error.Message, errorCode));
        }

        var published = await lifecycle.PublishAsync(
            resolved.Value.TenantId,
            code,
            saved.Value!.VersionNumber,
            new PlantProcess.Application.Definitions.Canvas.CanvasProjectionHandles(
                null, request.DisplayName, request.CanonicalEntity, user.Identity?.Name ?? "canvas"),
            ct);

        if (published.IsFailure)
        {
            return Results.Ok(new SaveSqlVersionResponse(false, 0, null, published.Error!.Message, published.Error.Code));
        }

        return Results.Ok(new SaveSqlVersionResponse(
            true,
            published.Value!.VersionNumber,
            published.Value.VersionId.ToString(),
            "Published version " + published.Value.VersionNumber + " of " + code
            + ". Canonical definition " + published.Value.DefinitionId + "; immutable; the forked graph travels inside it.",
            null));
    }

    public sealed record MethodDto(
        string Code,
        string DisplayName,
        string Group,
        string AppliesTo,
        string Rationale,
        bool IsImplemented);

    private static IResult GetMethods()
    {
        // Projected from MethodSelector's own rules, so the palette cannot
        // offer a method the selector would call NotApplicable, and the
        // rationale a user reads is the same sentence the engine records.
        var catalogue = new List<MethodDto>
        {
            new("Spearman", "Spearman rank correlation", "Correlation",
                "numeric / numeric",
                MethodSelector.Select(VariableType.Numeric, VariableType.Numeric).Rationale, true),

            new("MutualInformation", "Mutual information", "Correlation",
                "numeric / numeric, non-monotonic",
                MethodSelector.Select(VariableType.Numeric, VariableType.Numeric, numericRelationshipNonlinear: true).Rationale, true),

            new("PointBiserial", "Point-biserial correlation", "Correlation",
                "binary / numeric",
                MethodSelector.Select(VariableType.Binary, VariableType.Numeric).Rationale, true),

            new("CramersV", "Cramer's V", "Association",
                "categorical / categorical",
                MethodSelector.Select(VariableType.Categorical, VariableType.Categorical).Rationale, true),

            new("LassoVif", "Lasso screen with VIF", "Multivariate",
                "many or collinear predictors",
                MethodSelector.Select(VariableType.Numeric, VariableType.Numeric, manyCollinearPredictors: true).Rationale, true),
        };

        return Results.Ok(new
        {
            // Stated on the wire so a client can show it and nobody has to read
            // this file to learn it.
            source = "code",
            note = "Projected from AnalysisMethod and MethodSelector. Becomes registry-driven "
                 + "when ml_method_definitions lands; this contract does not change.",
            methods = catalogue,
        });
    }
}
